dedupe_keys.name: marlinks ns das dataset for vessel detection and distance estimation using distributed acoustic sensing in submarine optical fiber cables

description: Erick Ramirez-Torres and colleagues publish processed acoustic-sensing features for submarine-cable protection offshore Zeebrugge, Belgium. The measurements cover 16–25 June 2023 along a 2,553-metre segment of an existing optical cable. The README defines 74,771 ten-second observations, each with a 250-by-100 channel–frequency matrix, closest-vessel distance and anonymised AIS attributes. HDF5 data and documentation are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. They can support vessel-detection and cable-exposure simulations, although raw recordings and the precise cable route are withheld. Three noisy channels are zeroed, and the README recommends splitting by day to limit temporal leakage. AIS-derived labels may miss vessels not represented in the source AIS observations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. The README resolves an inconsistent matrix-shape statement in the landing-page summary; data arrays and reported model performance were not checked.
